items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I was -- arranged two numbers in that band, one -- the first one was called, 'Carrie,' which was a tune written by Edith Wilson. And that was one of our numbers we did on the stage... And I did and we recorded it in Paris.

ctx.x: We had Slow Kid Thompson as a comedian and Edith Wilson, and we had a few chorus girls, that went to Europe with Sam.
